the other stuff is my girlfriend. we've been together almost 3 years and lately it feels like im the only one putting any effort in. planning everything, remembering everything. im tired
That sounds worn down and maybe a bit hurt too, from carrying so much of the keeping-things-going. Does it feel more like pressure, or more like feeling let down?

more pressure i think. like its all on me. we're supposed to move in together in august and im doing all the apartment hunting, the budget spreadsheet, calling people. she just says 'whatever you think is best' and it makes me want to scream
That “whatever you think is best” sounds like it lands on you as another load to carry, especially with the apartment hunting, the budget spreadsheet, and the calls.

yeah exactly. and i dont even think she gets that its work. like the spreadsheet doesnt make itself. i keep thinking if i just stopped doing all of it would anything even happen or would we just not have an apartment

It sounds like the pressure is now tangled with a sharper question, whether anything would happen at all if you stopped carrying it. What feels most present in that thought, the fear of things falling apart or the feeling of being taken for granted?

taken for granted. definitely that. i dont think shes a bad person she just defaults to letting me handle it and ive let that happen for 3 years so its kind of my fault too. i need to actually say something to her instead of venting to an app lol

nah i think im good. this actually helped me figure out what to say more than i expected. thanks. gonna go talk to her
